# Shiverbug Studios

> Independent video game studio in North East England, founded in 2025. Building Out of Water, a 2-player split-screen collectathon platformer, and taking on co-development and work-for-hire: concept art, 3D art, level design and gameplay programming.

Team of 11 people plus a talent pool of 5 regular collaborators. Contact: contact@shiverbugstudios.com

## Studio

- [Home](https://olivernealdev.github.io/ShiverbugStudiosWebsite/): studio overview, Out of Water, the team
- [Co-development and work-for-hire](https://olivernealdev.github.io/ShiverbugStudiosWebsite/): services, galleries, packages, process, FAQ - this is the home page
- [Press kit](https://olivernealdev.github.io/ShiverbugStudiosWebsite/press.html): fact sheet, logos, screenshots, trailer
- [Privacy policy](https://olivernealdev.github.io/ShiverbugStudiosWebsite/privacy.html)
- [Accessibility statement](https://olivernealdev.github.io/ShiverbugStudiosWebsite/accessibility.html): WCAG 2.2 AA conformance, known gaps, how to report a problem
